headline_marked: [[Jubo Mohila League leader found dead]] in Keraniganj flat
headline: Jubo Mohila League leader found dead in Keraniganj flat
summary: Dalia Akter, a former local leader and primary school teacher, was found killed in her bedroom on Friday morning.
details: Police recovered the body of Dalia Akter, 50, from the bedroom of her flat in the Sonali Bank building at Rasulpur Bazar in Basta Union, South Keraniganj.
Dalia was the president of the Basta Union Jubo Mohila League, an organization whose activities are currently banned, and served as an assistant teacher at Char Baghapura Government Primary School.
According to police, the victim had injuries on her neck caused by a sharp weapon. The body was sent to Sir Salimullah Medical College (Mitford) morgue for an autopsy.
Local sources stated that Dalia lived alone in the flat after her divorce and after her two daughters had married.
Inspector (Investigation) Azgar Ali of South Keraniganj Police Station confirmed that the CID Crime Unit is currently working at the scene and an investigation is underway.
caption:

According to police, the victim had injuries on her neck caused by a sharp weapon. The body was sent to Sir Salimullah Medical College (Mitford) morgue for an autopsy.

Local sources stated that Dalia lived alone in the flat after her divorce and after her two daughters had married.

Inspector (Investigation) Azgar Ali of South Keraniganj Police Station confirmed that the CID Crime Unit is currently working at the scene and an investigation is underway.
